mapper.select: SELECT a_id, a_login_id, a_password, a_name, a_email, a_phone, a_role, created_by, created_at, updated_at FROM admin
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin (a_login_id, a_password, a_name, a_email, a_phone, a_role, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{aLoginId}, #{aPassword}, #{aName}, #{aEmail}, #{aPhone}, #{aRole}, #{createdBy}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE admin SET a_login_id = #{aLoginId}, a_password = #{aPassword}, a_name = #{aName}, a_email = #{aEmail}, a_phone = #{aPhone}, a_role = #{aRole}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE a_id = #{aId}
UPDATE admin SET a_password = #{aPassword}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE a_id = #{aId}
